existing_assets_reviewed.reason: It already provides app-neutral OptiX custom-AABB row output with fail-closed capacity handling, but it is 2-D point/AABB membership rows, not the Goal5140 nearest-state frontier row schema.
Cell MBRs can be represented as custom AABBs and traversed through the existing generic custom-primitive acceleration pattern.
It demonstrates 3-D query launch, payload-style nearest/radius behavior, and CUDA module loading, but its data model is point-neighbor rows rather than cell-MBR nearest frontiers.
It proves native nearest-witness device-column handoff patterns exist, but it is 2-D point-group nearest witness, not generic cell-MBR frontier classification.

missing_backend_surface: No current backend emits Goal5140 row schema with inline/offload/pruned frontier kind codes.
No current backend combines cell-MBR traversal with caller-provided current nearest state and max_inline_points classification.
No current Embree/HIPRT equivalent exists for this ABI.

recommended_next_goal.name: Generic OptiX cell-MBR frontier backend spike
minimal_scope: Add a generic native symbol following the Goal5140 ABI.
Use custom AABB acceleration over caller-owned cell MBRs.

Validate on a tiny synthetic non-X-HD fixture against the Goal5140 NumPy row-table reference.
not_in_scope: X-HD-specific primitive names or author-code copy

risk_register.description: The strongest existing AABB row-output API is 2-D; X-HD representative graphics inputs are 3-D.
risk_register.mitigation: Start with one OptiX backend spike that is explicitly checked against synthetic 3-D cell-MBR fixtures before app integration.

risk_register.description: Frontier row count can exceed caller capacity.
risk_register.mitigation: Reuse the existing AABB row-output discipline: overflow must fail closed, never emit partial success.

risk_register.description: Because this work is motivated by X-HD, backend names could drift toward X-HD or Hausdorff semantics.
risk_register.mitigation: Native symbol, Python wrapper, tests, and metadata must use cell-MBR/frontier/nearest-state terminology only.

risk_register.description: A tiny backend smoke can prove ABI correctness but not paper performance.
risk_register.mitigation: Goal5142 must be correctness-only unless a separate phase-aligned performance goal is authorized.

allowed: Existing generic native assets make an OptiX implementation plausible.
